mcqs.question: Which combination correctly describes the sports programme of the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow?
options: 74 countries, 10 sports, six integrated Para Sports and four venues
48 countries, 10 sports, six integrated Para Sports and four venues
74 countries, 10 sports, four integrated Para Sports and six venues
74 countries, six sports, 10 integrated Para Sports and four venues
mcqs.explanation: The 2026 Commonwealth Games involved 74 countries, a 10-sport programme, six integrated Para Sports and four venues. The other options alter one of these four details, especially the number of countries, Para Sports or venues.

mcqs.question: How many athletes were included in India's contingent for the 2026 Commonwealth Games, and what was its gender-wise composition?
mcqs.explanation: India's contingent comprised 124 athletes, including 78 men and 46 women. The tempting second option reverses the gender-wise figures, while the other options change the total or composition.

mcqs.question: What was India's medal tally at the 2026 Commonwealth Games by 27 July 2026?
options: One gold, two silver and one bronze
Two gold, one silver and one bronze
One gold, one silver and two bronze
Two gold, two silver and one bronze
mcqs.explanation: By 27 July 2026, India had won four medals: one gold, two silver and one bronze. The other options change the distribution of the four medals.

mcqs.question: Under the July 2026 Khelo India update, how many infrastructure projects were recorded and what was their value?
mcqs.explanation: The update recorded 349 Khelo India infrastructure projects involving ₹3,176 crore. The other options substitute the number of academies, the sports budget or the number of Khelo India Centres.

mcqs.question:
Match the Khelo India items in List-I with their corresponding numbers in List-II.

List-I
(a) Academies
(b) Khelo India Athletes
(c) Athletes in Khelo India Games since 2018

List-II
(i) 63,000+
(ii) 267
(iii) 2,745
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Academies—267, Khelo India Athletes—2,745, and athletes in Khelo India Games since 2018—63,000+. The other codes interchange these three figures.

mcqs.question: Which option presents the Khelo India Games in chronological order of their introduction?
options: School Games; Youth Games; University Games and Winter Games; Para Games; Beach Games and Water Sports Festival; Tribal Games
Youth Games; School Games; University Games and Winter Games; Para Games; Beach Games and Water Sports Festival; Tribal Games
School Games; University Games and Winter Games; Youth Games; Para Games; Tribal Games; Beach Games and Water Sports Festival
School Games; Youth Games; Para Games; University Games and Winter Games; Beach Games and Water Sports Festival; Tribal Games
mcqs.explanation: The sequence begins with School Games in 2018, followed by Youth Games in 2019, University Games and Winter Games in 2020, Para Games in 2023, Beach Games and Water Sports Festival in 2025, and Tribal Games in 2026. Each incorrect option changes at least one position in this sequence.

mcqs.question: Which Khelo India event was introduced in 2023?
options: Beach Games and Water Sports Festival
mcqs.explanation: The Para Games were introduced in 2023. University Games and Winter Games belong to 2020, Beach Games and Water Sports Festival to 2025, and Tribal Games to 2026.

mcqs.question:
With reference to the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS) update of April 2026, consider the following statements:

1. It included 51 core athletes.
2. It included 52 para core athletes.
3. It included 130 development athletes.
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct: the April 2026 TOPS composition included 51 core, 52 para core and 130 development athletes. The alternatives incorrectly omit one of the three categories.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:

Statement A: KIRTI identifies sporting talent in the 9–18 age group and aims for India to be among the top 10 by 2036 and top 5 by 2047.
Statement B: The Budget 2026–27 provided ₹500 crore for sports goods manufacturing.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. KIRTI is a talent-identification initiative for ages 9–18 with the stated 2036 and 2047 targets, while ₹500 crore was provided for sports goods manufacturing in Budget 2026–27.

mcqs.question:
Match the events in List-I with India's medal totals in the specified editions in List-II.

List-I
(a) Olympics: Paris 2024
(b) Paralympics: Paris 2024
(c) Asian Games: Hangzhou 2023
(d) Commonwealth Games: Gold Coast 2018

List-II
(i) 66
(ii) 107
(iii) 6
(iv) 29
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Paris 2024 Olympics—6, Paris 2024 Paralympics—29, Hangzhou 2023 Asian Games—107, and Gold Coast 2018 Commonwealth Games—66. The other options interchange the medal totals among the four events.

mcqs.question: Which innovation was introduced for the first time at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
mcqs.explanation: Braille medals were introduced for the first time at the 2026 Commonwealth Games. The other options refer to features of the Games programme or venue arrangement, not the stated first-time innovation.

mcqs.question: Who was India's flag-bearer at the 2026 Commonwealth Games and in which event did India win its first gold?
options: Chanambam Rishikanta Singh; men's 60 kg weightlifting
Chanambam Rishikanta Singh; women's 48 kg weightlifting
mcqs.explanation: Mirabai Chanu was India's flag-bearer and won India's first gold in women's 48 kg weightlifting. Chanambam Rishikanta Singh won India's first medal, a silver in men's 60 kg weightlifting, so the second option confuses the two athletes and achievements.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about the Commonwealth Games:

Statement A: Ahmedabad will host the 2030 Commonwealth Games.
Statement B: The 2030 edition will be the centenary edition.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true: Ahmedabad is the host of the 2030 Commonwealth Games, which is designated as the centenary edition. The other options incorrectly reject one or both details.

mcqs.question: Which description correctly identifies the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
options: The 23rd edition, held from 11 June to 19 July 2026, hosted by the USA, Canada and Mexico
The 23rd edition, held from 23 July to 2 August 2026, hosted by Glasgow
The 48th edition, held from 11 June to 19 July 2026, hosted by the USA, Canada and Mexico
The 23rd edition, held from 11 June to 19 July 2026, hosted by Spain, Argentina and England
mcqs.explanation: The 2026 FIFA World Cup was the 23rd edition, held from 11 June to 19 July 2026, with the USA, Canada and Mexico as hosts. The other options confuse it with the Commonwealth Games, alter the edition number or replace the host countries.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about the 2026 FIFA World Cup:

1. It featured 48 teams.
2. It had 104 matches.
3. A round of 32 was introduced for the first time.
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct. The 2026 World Cup featured 48 teams and 104 matches, and it introduced the round of 32 for the first time.

mcqs.question:
Match the FIFA World Cup 2026 awards in List-I with the recipients in List-II.

List-I
(a) Golden Ball
(b) Golden Boot
(c) Golden Glove

List-II
(i) Unai Simón
(ii) Kylian Mbappé
(iii) Rodri
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Golden Ball—Rodri, Golden Boot—Kylian Mbappé, and Golden Glove—Unai Simón. The other codes interchange the three awards and recipients.

mcqs.question: Which country became the first to host FIFA World Cup matches in three editions?
mcqs.explanation: Mexico became the first country to host World Cup matches in three editions: 1970, 1986 and 2026. Spain, Argentina and England are mentioned in the tournament context but do not hold this stated hosting record.

mcqs.question: Which combination correctly identifies FIFA's establishment year, headquarters and president?
mcqs.explanation: FIFA was established in 1904, has its headquarters in Zurich and is headed by President Gianni Infantino. The other options replace one of these institutional details with a tournament date, venue or award recipient.
